text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyaaa-hahaha! Rejoice, Lady Furioso!! As a 
birthday gift, allow me to bestow upon you 
a scroll of military strategy penned by 
mine own hand!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...A book on military strategy? I don't 
engage in battles, though..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wage it day in and day out, do I not? A 
righteous battle against the Central for 
the sake of my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*! ...Are you saying you will lend 
your wisdom to that battle?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Fighting a lone battle is 
admirable, but a frontal assault against a 
massive army puts the odds against you. It 
would be wise to devise an unorthodox 
tactic to stir things up.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
First of all, we need a scheme to make the 
entire academy revere Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What is your angle? You wouldn't act 
without personal gain just because it's 
someone's birthday.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A-Advantages, you say... If I had to put 
it into words, my blood simply boils with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The winds favor the enemy, and all 
proclaim our disadvantage. To overturn 
such a dire battlefield and seize victory 
from below— oh, how thrilling it is!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You carry quite a troublesome pedigree. 
...Yet, it seems you speak with honesty.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I am most glad to see that you understand. 
Ah, but rest assured, I truly do wish to 
celebrate you as well! Do not go 
forgetting that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. However, simply reading a 
manual of military tactics does not 
guarantee one will comprehend the 
strategy."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Could I get some commentary from you too? 
...While snacking on some famous Funabashi 
sweets, perhaps.
